name: ModelScope
description: ModelScope (魔搭) API-Inference serves selected open models through an OpenAI-compatible API; calls are redeemed with free daily login credits (魔粒), and a linked, real-name-verified Alibaba Cloud account is required.
quota_note: Requires a ModelScope account linked to a real-name-verified Alibaba Cloud account; using credits also requires a verified profile email. Logging in each day grants 200 short-term credits, plus 50 more once an Alibaba Cloud account is linked; short-term credits expire after 24 hours. API-Inference calls cost about 0.5, 1 or 2 credits for lightweight, mainstream or flagship models, and calls are allowed while the credit balance lasts. Credits are shared with AIGC and training services, so this is not a fixed requests-per-day allowance. Concurrency is adjusted dynamically, aiming to keep single-concurrency use working. The service is free and non-commercial, intended for development and evaluation, and should not be used for workloads needing high concurrency or an SLA.
pricing_note: Free-only: API-Inference is a non-commercial free service that deducts ModelScope credits per call, not per token; no paid per-token rate is published.
catalog_note: This selection includes three current models whose IDs appear in the public /v1/models list as of 2026-11-19. Older models may be withdrawn from API-Inference as new ones launch. Authenticated inference has not been checked.
